title.value: Generating Stable and Collision-Free Policies through Lyapunov Function Learning
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: Generating Stable and Collision-Free Policies through Lyapunov Function Learning

extractions.description: The paper introduces a novel method for learning a Lyapunov function and a policy using a single neural network model to generate stable and collision-free motion planning policies for robots, validated in simulation and real-world scenarios.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: While the paper discusses robotics and automation, it does not directly focus on or significantly contribute to sustainable development themes.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: With the growing number of robots in industry and in human environments, the need for ease of deployment and safety in robotics becomes increasingly apparent.

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily focuses on robotics, automation, and machine learning techniques for motion planning, and it doesn't directly address any of the defined Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development categories.
primary_category.quote: In this paper, we propose a novel method for learning both the Lyapunov function and policy with a single neural network.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper's focus on robotics and motion planning does not align with any of the defined Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development sub-categories.
primary_sub_category.quote: To produce a stable policy, we train the network using a constrained optimization formulation with stability conditions as constraints.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper's primary focus is on robotics and does not fit into existing categories.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper's primary focus is on robotics and does not fit into existing subcategories.
